data.title: US, Saudi Arabia clashed during Iran war over Operation Project Freedom | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: According to the WSJ, Saudi Arabia refused to allow the United States to use its bases and airspace for the mission. In retaliation, the White House threatened to withhold interception systems.
